sentence_stem: It is very hot in here.
full_sentence: It is very hot in here. Open the window, please.

options.why_wrong: Imperative sentences do not use a subject such as 'I'. The verb comes first.
The imperative uses the base form of the verb, without the -s ending.
The imperative uses the base form of the verb, not the -ing form.

explanation: An imperative sentence gives an instruction. It starts with the base form of the verb and has no subject. Portuguese speakers may add a subject or change the verb ending, because Portuguese imperatives have separate endings for each person.
translation: Está muito quente aqui. Abra a janela, por favor.
